item.description:
Gemini through Antigravity

SubFuse now supports four providers: ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, and Gemini through Antigravity.

  • Connect Gemini using the signed-in Antigravity desktop app and view its reported allowance pools and resets.
  • Use custom names, costs and currencies, renewals, trials, calendar reminders, and freshness confirmation.
  • Refresh individually, with Refresh all, or on your profile's optional background schedule.
  • Account checks protect saved subscriptions; failed refreshes preserve the last reading.

Keep Antigravity running and signed in to the account you want to refresh. Allowances are those reported by Antigravity, not Gemini consumer-chat or API limits. Older versions may provide cached readings.

The integration passed automated and synthetic UI tests; live Antigravity account verification is pending. Its internal desktop interface may change. Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 14+. This beta is ad hoc signed, not Apple-notarized.
